name: cancel_counters_a_creature_spell
notes: P744a5c3831 G4. Printed: 'Counter target spell.' Seat 0 casts Highborn Vampire (a creature spell, {3}{B}). The response window asks seat 1, who holds Cancel and exactly {1}{U}{U}; it casts Cancel at the Vampire, which is countered: it goes to its owner's graveyard and never enters. Cancel goes to the graveyard and seat 1's pool is spent. Converted 2026-11-11 to real priority (docs/DESIGN_PRIORITY.md): the response window is gone, so the answer is a spell cast while the first waits on the stack ("hold").
